title: TruSeq RNA Preparation with Modification for Four Rounds of Poly-A Selection
author: Dr. Daniel Richter
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.imucc6w
materials: Pre-heat the thermal cycler lid to 100ºC
Pop bubbles with a 30 gauge needle

steps.title: Prepare RNA Purification Beads
steps.instruction: Vortex RNA Purification Beads (RPB) to resuspend and let them stand at room temperature (RT) for 30 minutes before use.

steps.title: Perform Initial Poly-A Selection
steps.instruction: Bind and purify poly-A RNA using RPB.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 µL RPB to RNA.
Run the mRNA Denaturation program; remove PCR tubes when the cycler reaches 4ºC.
Incubate tubes at RT for 5 minutes to allow RNA to bind to beads.
Place tubes on a magnetic stand at RT for 5 minutes.
Remove and discard the supernatant without disturbing the beads.
Remove tubes from the magnetic stand.
Wash beads with Bead Washing Buffer (BWB), mixing by pipetting up and down 6 times.
Place tubes on a magnetic stand at RT for 5 minutes.
Remove and discard the supernatant.
Remove tubes from the magnetic stand.

steps.title: Elute mRNA
steps.instruction: Release the bound mRNA from the beads.

substeps.instruction: Add Elution Buffer (ELB) to each tube and mix by pipetting up and down 6 times.
Run the mRNA Elution 1 program; remove tubes when the cycler reaches 25ºC.
Place tubes on the benchtop at RT.

steps.title: Perform Second Poly-A Selection
steps.instruction: Re-bind mRNA to beads to reduce rRNA contamination.

substeps.instruction: Add Bead Binding Buffer (BBB) to each tube and mix by pipetting up and down 6 times.
Place tubes on a magnetic stand at RT for 5 minutes.
Remove and discard supernatant without disturbing the beads.
Remove tubes from the magnetic stand.
Wash beads with Bead Washing Buffer (BWB), mixing by pipetting up and down 6 times.
Place tubes on a magnetic stand for 5 minutes.
Remove and discard all supernatant.
Remove tubes from the magnetic stand.

steps.title: Iterate Poly-A Selection or Fragment
steps.instruction: Depending on the round of selection, either repeat the process or proceed to fragmentation.

substeps.instruction: If this is the first time through the protocol, repeat the Poly-A Selection process.
If this is the second time through the protocol, add 18 µL of Elute, Prime, Fragment Mix (EPF) to each tube and mix by pipetting up and down 6 times.
Add Elution Buffer (ELB) to each tube and mix by pipetting up and down 6 times.
Pre-heat thermal cycler to 80ºC; incubate tubes for 2 minutes at 80ºC.
Immediately transfer tubes to the magnetic stand to prevent mRNA re-binding.
Immediately transfer supernatant to a new set of tubes after beads aggregate.

steps.title: Final Poly-A Selection and Elution
steps.instruction: Perform final cleanup and elution of fragmented/primed mRNA.

substeps.instruction: Repeat the protocol from the RPB vortexing step through the addition of EPF mix.
Pre-heat the thermal cycler lid to 100ºC.
Run the 'Elution 2 - Frag - Prime' program.
Remove tubes when the cycler reaches 4ºC and centrifuge briefly.
Place tubes on a magnetic stand at RT for 5 minutes.
Transfer supernatant (fragmented and primed mRNA) to new tubes.

steps.title: Synthesize First Strand cDNA
steps.instruction: Convert mRNA to first strand cDNA.

substeps.instruction: Add First Strand Master Mix (FSM)/SuperScript II (thawed at RT from -20ºC) to each tube.
Mix by pipetting up and down 6 times.
Immediately return FSM/SuperScript II to -20ºC.
Run the first strand program; remove tubes when the cycler reaches 4ºC.

steps.title: Synthesize Second Strand cDNA
steps.instruction: Convert first strand cDNA to double-stranded cDNA (ds cDNA).

substeps.instruction: Add thawed Second Strand Master Mix (SSM) (thawed at RT from -20ºC) to each tube.
Mix by pipetting up and down 6 times.
Pre-heat thermal cycler to 16ºC; incubate tubes at 16ºC for 1 hour.
Remove tubes and let stand to bring to RT.

steps.title: Purify ds cDNA
steps.instruction: Clean ds cDNA using AMPure XP beads.

substeps.instruction: Vortex AMPure XP beads (stored at 4ºC, let stand at RT for 30 min) until dispersed.
Add 90 µL beads to each tube containing 50 µL ds cDNA.
Mix by pipetting the entire volume up and down 10 times.
Incubate at RT for 15 minutes.
Place on magnetic stand at RT for 5 minutes.
Remove and discard 135 µL supernatant.
Add 80% EtOH to tubes on the stand; incubate at RT for 30 seconds.
Remove and discard supernatant.
Repeat EtOH wash for a total of two washes.
Let tubes stand at RT for 15 minutes to dry, then remove from stand.
Add Resuspension Buffer (RSB), mix by pipetting up and down 10 times.
Incubate at RT for 2 minutes.
Place on magnetic stand at RT for 5 minutes.
Transfer 60 µL supernatant (ds cDNA) to new tubes (safe storage at -20ºC).
Add End Repair Mix (ERP) (thawed at RT from -20ºC) to each tube.
Mix by pipetting the entire volume up and down 10 times using a 100 µL pipette setting.
Pre-heat thermal cycler to 30ºC; incubate tubes at 30ºC for 30 minutes.
Remove tubes from the thermal cycler.

steps.title: Purify End Repaired cDNA
steps.instruction: Clean end-repaired cDNA using AMPure XP beads.

substeps.instruction: Vortex AMPure XP beads (stored at 4ºC, let stand at RT for 30 min) until dispersed.
Add 160 µL beads to each tube containing 100 µL sample.
Mix by pipetting up and down 10 times using a 200 µL pipette setting.
Incubate at RT for 15 minutes.
Place on magnetic stand for 5 minutes or until liquid is clear.
Remove and discard 127.5 µL supernatant; repeat this removal step once.
Add freshly prepared 80% EtOH to tubes on the stand; incubate at RT for 30 seconds.
Remove and discard supernatant.
Repeat EtOH wash for a total of two washes.
Let tubes stand at RT for 15 minutes to dry, then remove from stand.
Resuspend pellet in Resuspension Buffer (RSB) (stored at -20ºC, let stand at RT for 30 min).
Mix by pipetting up and down 10 times.
Incubate at RT for 2 minutes.
Place on magnetic stand at RT for 5 minutes or until clear.
Transfer 17.5 µL clear supernatant to new tubes (safe storage at -20ºC).
Add A-Tailing Mix (ATL) (thawed at RT from -20ºC) to each tube.
Mix by pipetting the entire volume up and down 10 times using a 30 µL pipette setting.
Pre-heat thermal cycler to 37ºC; incubate tubes at 37ºC for 30 minutes.
Immediately remove tubes from the thermal cycler.

steps.title: Ligate Adapters
steps.instruction: Ligate RNA adapter indexes to the cDNA.

substeps.instruction: Remove Ligation Mix (LIG) from -20ºC immediately before use.
Add Resuspension Buffer (RSB) (stored at -20ºC, let stand at RT for 30 min) to each tube.
Add Ligation Mix (LIG) to each tube; return LIG to -20ºC immediately after use.
Add appropriate RNA Adapter Index (thawed at RT from -20ºC) to each tube.
Mix by pipetting the entire volume up and down 10 times using a 37.5 µL pipette setting.
Pre-heat thermal cycler to 30ºC; incubate tubes at 30ºC for 10 minutes.
Remove tubes from the thermal cycler.

steps.title: Clean Ligation Products
steps.instruction: Perform two rounds of AMPure XP bead cleanup.

substeps.instruction: Add Stop Ligation Buffer (STL) (thawed at RT from -20ºC) to each tube; mix by pipetting up and down 10 times using a 42.5 µL pipette setting.
Vortex AMPure XP beads (stored at 4ºC, let stand at RT for 30 min) until dispersed.
Add beads to each tube; mix by pipetting up and down 10 times using an 85 µL pipette setting.
Incubate at RT for 15 minutes.
Place on magnetic stand at RT for 5 minutes or until clear.
Remove and discard 79.5 µL supernatant.
Add freshly prepared 80% EtOH to tubes on the stand; incubate at RT for 30 seconds.
Remove and discard supernatant; repeat for a total of two EtOH washes.
Let tubes stand at RT for 15 minutes to dry, then remove from stand.
Resuspend pellet in RSB (stored at -20ºC, let stand at RT for 30 min); mix by pipetting up and down 10 times.
Incubate at RT for 2 minutes.
Place on magnetic stand at RT for 5 minutes or until clear.
Transfer 50 µL clear supernatant to new tubes.
Perform a second cleanup: Vortex AMPure XP beads, add to tubes, and mix by pipetting up and down 10 times using a 100 µL pipette setting.
Incubate at RT for 15 minutes.
Place on magnetic stand at RT for 5 minutes or until clear.
Remove and discard 95 µL supernatant.
Add freshly prepared 80% EtOH to tubes on the stand; incubate at RT for 30 seconds.
Remove and discard supernatant; repeat for a total of two EtOH washes.
Let tubes stand at RT for 15 minutes to dry, then remove from stand.
Resuspend pellet in RSB; mix by pipetting up and down 10 times.
Incubate at RT for 2 minutes.
Place on magnetic stand at RT for 5 minutes or until clear.
Transfer 20 µL clear supernatant to new tubes (safe storage at -20ºC).
Add thawed PCR Primer Cocktail (PPC) (stored at -20ºC, thawed at RT, kept on ice) to each tube.
Add thawed PCR Master Mix (PMM) (stored at -20ºC, thawed at RT, kept on ice) to each tube.
Mix by pipetting the entire volume up and down 10 times using a 50 µL pipette setting.
Run the PCR program.

steps.title: Final Library Purification
steps.instruction: Perform final bead cleanup and a modified repeat for specific aliquots.

substeps.instruction: Vortex AMPure XP beads (stored at 4ºC, let stand at RT for 30 min) until dispersed.
Add beads to each tube; mix by pipetting up and down 10 times using a 100 µL pipette setting.
Incubate at RT for 15 minutes.
Place on magnetic stand at RT for 5 minutes or until clear.
Remove and discard 95 µL supernatant.
Add freshly prepared 80% EtOH to tubes on the stand; incubate at RT for 30 seconds.
Remove and discard supernatant; repeat for a total of two EtOH washes.
Let tubes stand at RT for 15 minutes to dry, then remove from stand.
Resuspend pellet in RSB (stored at -20ºC, let stand at RT for 30 min); mix by pipetting up and down 10 times.
Incubate at RT for 2 minutes.
Place on magnetic stand at RT for 5 minutes or until clear.
Transfer 50 µL clear supernatant to new tubes.
Repeat the purification steps (154-170) once, but modify: add 31 µL RSB in the resuspension step and transfer 30 µL to separate 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes in the final step.

steps.title: Quality Control and Storage
steps.instruction: Quantify and analyze the final library.

substeps.instruction: Take one aliquot for Qubit and one for qPCR in 1.5 mL tubes; freeze cleaned PCR and both aliquots at -20ºC.
Prepare Qubit working solution: mix 7 µL Qubit dsDNA HS reagent with 1393 µL Qubit dsDNA HS buffer.
Prepare standards 1 and 2: mix 10 µL of each standard with 190 µL working solution in separate assay tubes.
Dilute 1 µL of each library into 199 µL working solution (1:200 dilution).
Vortex all tubes for 2-3 seconds and incubate at RT for 2 minutes.
Read standards and library samples on the Qubit 2.0 Fluorometer and record concentration (ng/mL).
Dilute 1 µL aliquots of each library to 300 pg/µL (divide Qubit concentration by 1.5 to determine dilution ratio).

Prepare Bioanalyzer: equilibrate gel-dye mix to RT for 30 min (if not prepared, mix 15 µL HS DNA dye concentrate into HS DNA gel matrix vial, vortex, spin down, transfer to spin filter, and centrifuge at 2240 xg +/- 20% for 10 min).
Clean Bioanalyzer electrodes with 350 µL nuclease-free water using a cleaning chip.
Set chip priming station: syringe clip at lowest position, base plate at position C, plunger at 1 mL.
Pipette gel-dye mix into the well at the third row, last column.
Lock chip into priming station, press plunger until held by clip, wait 1 minute, release clip, wait 5 seconds, and pull plunger back to 1 mL.
Remove chip and pipette gel-dye mix into the remaining 3 wells of the last column.
Pipette marker (green) into all sample and ladder wells.
Pipette HS DNA ladder (yellow) into the well marked with a ladder (third column, last row).
Pipette diluted 300 pg/µL library aliquots into wells 1-11.
Add marker (green) into each unused well.
Vortex chip for 1 min at 2400 rpm; remove cleaning chip and leave Bioanalyzer open to dry electrodes during vortexing.
Run the chip in the Agilent 2100 Bioanalyzer within 5 minutes.
